title: #sadboysinharpyland #sadboysph #playwrightshorizons #soloperformance ...
transcript: last night I saw Sad Boys in Harpy Land at Playwrights Horizons and in many ways It’s indescribable it's a solo show written and performed by Alexandra Tatarsky and my take is that it's a meditation on art and being a theater artist specifically when it feels like the world's falling apart. somewhat contrary to this description though, the show is very funny and deeply absurd. one of the recurring lines of the show is “my mind is a hellscape” and overall the tone of the piece is extremely chaotic. Alexandra hilariously captures the anxiety and existential crisis around being a person and quote “doing nothing” while the world around us burns. the show is really out there and probably not everyone's cup of tea but I enjoyed it and I thought it was quite funny, particularly the physicality and the prop work. with that, another program for my collection
